title: CRC spatial impact evaluation record 1.0
description: Application record for a spatial combination. Never assigns a single function hash to an application that evaluated multiple definitions; function identities live in child records and the contributor snapshot.

schema_version.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

policy_hash.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

contributors.description: Contributor snapshot mapping stable IDs to source, selection, alignment and function identities.

contributor_count.x-crc-canonical: JSON integer without fraction or exponent

combined_exposure.description: Combined exposure identity for the exposure stage; null for the impact stage.

x-crc-rules: policy_hash equals the content hash of the canonical policy.
exposure stage: combined_exposure is present and children is one target child with null contributor_id.
impact stage: combined_exposure is null and children has one record per contributor with unique ids.
Provided weights require a weight unit.

identifier.description: Non-empty, case-sensitive string without surrounding whitespace.

number.description: JSON number converted once to finite IEEE binary64; booleans and strings are rejected.

sha256.description: Bare SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

content_hash.description: Prefixed content identity: sha256 of the canonical JSON bytes.

h3_cell.description: H3 cell index as 15 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

weights_intersection_area.description: Weights are contributor intersection areas with the target.
